rules.statement: In a possessory action, whether brought by the owner suo nomine or as lessee, the subject-matter is the right to possess the whole land without limitation in point of time, and the jurisdiction of the Court should be determined by the value of that right.
rules.supporting_quote: "The question for decision is whether the test of jurisdiction in. a possessory action brought by a lessee is the value of the land or the value of the remaining period of the lease."
